title: Quick Comforting Irish Potato Gratin
description: A peppery, crisp, and comforting Irish dish featuring heavy cream and broiled to perfection, this gratin is a raw-friendly delight.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes and heavy cream, tossing to coat.
In a separate bowl, mix together the grated cheddar cheese, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes.
Sprinkle a third of the cheese mixture over the potatoes.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Dot the top of the cheese with the butter.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and broil for an additional 5 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
